Members

insertTitleSlot

Inserts the rewrite slot above the description: an aria-hidden spacer holds the layout space (zero reflow when the clone animates) and a replays the title. The whole slot is aria-hidden — the original h2 remains the single a11y source for the title.

  • @param cardEl The expanded mosaic card.
  • @param titleText The title string the slot replays.

mountBurn

Mounts the combustion canvas over the title's current box: measures the h2 and overlay at hover-instant and plays the dissolve exactly where the glyphs stand. The DOM ink hides as soon as the canvas takes over, so the card's expand ease running behind it can't double-draw the title at its moving flex-end position.

  • @param cardEl The expanded mosaic card.
  • @param overlay The title overlay element (canvas parent).
  • @param titleEl The h2 whose ink the canvas replaces.
  • @param item The card's mosaic item (description length paces the burn).
